datasets.title: Saint Helena - GRID3 SHN - Settlement Extents v3.0
datasets.description: The GRID3 SHN - Settlement Extents v3.0 consists of a geographic representation of settlements in Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha, in two forms: (1) settlement polygons, and (2) spatial points depicting the centroids of settled grid cells at 3-arc seconds (or ~100 meters) contained within settlement polygons. Both layers include attributes as described in the codebooks. Recommended Citation: Center for International Earth Science Information Network (CIESIN), Columbia University. 2024. entity.name: Center for International Earth Science Information Network (CIESIN), Columbia University

lineage.description: Settlement extents were delineated from satellite imagery and ancillary data sources, then gridded at 3-arc second (~100 meter) resolution to produce both polygon-based settlement boundaries and point-based grid cell centroids representing settled areas in Saint Helena, Ascension, and Tristan da Cunha.

sources.description: Geospatial settlement mapping and population distribution data derived from satellite imagery and census information to create settlement extents and gridded population centroids.
